blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Fingerprint salt rotation must not create fake novelty

blueprintSignals.name: Login failure burst
blueprintSignals.definition: failed attempts against the account in 15 minutes
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Count attempts before the success only

label: For "Account Takeover Detection": Detect credential-stuffing and session-hijack logins in real time and step up authentication without adding friction for real users. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Labels come only from users who reported fraud.
